slide-30deg-mu0p2.tolerance_reason: Proposed 1% [confirm]. The source gives no tolerance (TP 'Test benches'). MuJoCo friction is a soft, regularized constraint (elliptic cone, impratio 10); exploratory runs on this build differed from the formula by at most 0.03%, so 1% leaves margin for solver settings while still failing a wrong friction law (a frictionless block would be off by more than 30%).
